item.title: XRING — XQUIC QPACK Ring Buffer Resize Underflow (Remote Unauthenticated DoS)
item.description: Critical severity — network. Status: Weaponized (public PoC, unpatched at publication). Affects: [alibaba/xquic](https://github.com/alibaba/xquic) — QUIC/HTTP-3 library, used by Tengine and reportedly across Alibaba's cloud/CDN infrastructure (Taobao, AliPay). Tags: quic, http3, qpack, xquic, alibaba, tengine, ring-buffer, integer-underflow, heap-oob-read, memcpy, remote, unauthenticated, dos, no-cve.

item.title: Samsung SveService Native Out-of-Bounds Write (CVE-2026-21018)
item.description: High severity — binary · CVE-2026-21018 (Samsung SVE-2026-0478, SMR May 2026). Status: PoC. Affects: Samsung SveService (com.sec.sve) system service and its libsvejni.so native library. Tags: android, samsung, binder, native, out-of-bounds-write, jni, lpe, memcpy, memset.
